Definitions.units: Discombobulated: Sensors look misaligned for whatever reason. Could have been a bad install, or they could have shifted over time
Deeper sensor: Enough growth so that the sensors are noticeable deeper in the wood. ~ 5mm or more
Shallow install: Looks like not enough phloem was scraped away on the install
HD: Horizontal distance to sapflow box (meters)
VD: Vertical distance to sapflow box (meters)
Distance.to.base: SD measurement from the sensor to the tree base. Only done on trunk sensors (m)
Distance.to.leaves: SD measurement from sensor to the closest leaves. Only done on branch sensors (m)
